description: This file defines the 'Report' controller class for the OpenCart admin extension, handling report extension management including listing, installation, and uninstallation.

classes.name: Report
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing report extensions in the admin panel, including listing available reports, installing, and uninstalling them.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Outputs the list of report extensions.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares the list of available and installed report extensions, including their status and links.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles the installation process of a report extension, including permission checks, registering controllers, models, and configurations.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles the uninstallation process of a report extension, including permission checks and cleanup.
